017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.IoUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.stream.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.http.*;

027/**
028 * Default {@link RestClientDebugFormatter} implementation &mdash; secure by default.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * Request/response bodies are <b>never dumped by default</b>; dumping is a deliberate operator opt-in behind the
032 * {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES} environment-variable master gate, mirroring
033 * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter}'s server-side contract. See
034 * {@link #bodyScrubber(RestDebugBodyScrubber)} and {@link RestClientDebugFormatter#isBodyRenderable(String)} for the
035 * rest of the pipeline.
036 *
037 * @since 10.0.0
038 */
039public class BasicRestClientDebugFormatter implements RestClientDebugFormatter {
040
041   /** Default body capture cap, in bytes (8 KB). */
042   public static final int DEFAULT_BODY_CAP = 8 * 1024;
043
044   /**
045    * The environment variable that gates body dumping. Keep byte-identical to
046    * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter}'s counterpart — the same operator-facing
047    * kill switch must protect both the server and client debug pipelines.
048    */
049   static final String ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES = RestDebugBodyGate.ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES;
050
051   /**
052    * The widened, formatter-local default set of header names whose values are masked. Starts from a copy of
053    * {@link RedactedHeaders#DEFAULT} and adds the credential-bearing headers the shared default omits.
054    *
055    * <p>
056    * Keep byte-identical to {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter}'s counterpart.
057    */
058   static final Set<String> DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS;
059   static {
060      var s = new LinkedHashSet<>(RedactedHeaders.DEFAULT);
061      s.add("X-Auth-Token");
062      s.add("X-Authorization");
063      s.add("WWW-Authenticate");
064      s.add("Referer");
065      s.add("Location");
066      DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS = Collections.unmodifiableSet(s);
067   }
068
069   /** The set of header names whose values are masked. */
070   protected Set<String> redactedHeaders = DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS;
071
072   /** The set of query parameter names whose values are masked in the logged URI. */
073   protected Set<String> redactedQueryParams = RedactedQueryParams.DEFAULT;
074
075   /** Optional body scrubber applied to body text when the master gate is set. */
076   protected RestDebugBodyScrubber bodyScrubber;
077
078   /** The body capture cap in bytes. */
079   protected int bodyCap = DEFAULT_BODY_CAP;
080
081   /** Constructor. */
082   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter() {
083      /* no state to initialize */
084   }
085
086   /**
087    * Overrides the redacted-header set.
088    *
089    * @param value The new set of header names to mask.
090    * @return This object.
091    */
092   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter redactedHeaders(Collection<String> value) {
093      redactedHeaders = new LinkedHashSet<>(value);
094      return this;
095   }
096
097   /**
098    * Overrides the set of query parameter names whose values are masked in the logged URI.
099    *
100    * @param value The new set of parameter names to mask (case-insensitive). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
101    * @return This object.
102    */
103   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter redactedQueryParams(Collection<String> value) {
104      redactedQueryParams = new LinkedHashSet<>(value);
105      return this;
106   }
107
108   /**
109    * Extends the set of masked query parameter names additively (keeps the built-in protections).
110    *
111    * @param value The parameter names to add (case-insensitive). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
112    * @return This object.
113    */
114   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter addRedactedQueryParams(Collection<String> value) {
115      var s = new LinkedHashSet<>(redactedQueryParams);
116      s.addAll(value);
117      redactedQueryParams = s;
118      return this;
119   }
120
121   /**
122    * Sets the body scrubber applied to body text when the {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES} gate is set.
123    *
124    * <p>
125    * The scrubber only ever runs once dumping is already permitted by the gate; it chooses scrubbed-vs-raw body
126    * text. It is fail-closed: a throw or a <jk>null</jk> return yields a placeholder, never the raw body.
127    *
128    * @param value The scrubber, or <jk>null</jk> for none (the default, which dumps raw when gated).
129    * @return This object.
130    */
131   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter bodyScrubber(RestDebugBodyScrubber value) {
132      bodyScrubber = value;
133      return this;
134   }
135
136   /**
137    * Overrides the body capture cap.
138    *
139    * @param value The new cap in bytes.
140    * @return This object.
141    */
142   public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter bodyCap(int value) {
143      bodyCap = value;
144      return this;
145   }
146
147   @Override /* RestClientDebugFormatter */
148   public int bodyCap() {
149      return bodyCap;
150   }
151
152   @Override /* RestClientDebugFormatter */
153   public String formatBasic(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
154      var uri = req.getUri();
155      var method = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(req.getMethod());
156      var uriStr = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(uri != null ? RedactedQueryParams.redactUri(uri.toString(), redactedQueryParams) : "");
157      var sb = new StringBuilder();
158      // Prepend the resolved correlation id (same effective-id order as the emit stamp): the confirmed echoed id
159      // when present, else the sent id.  Both are already safe to interpolate (client-minted Uuid7 values are safe;
160      // a server-echoed value was sanitized server-side), so no second sanitizer pass is needed for this token.
161      var effectiveId = effectiveRequestId(req, res);
162      if (effectiveId != null)
163         sb.append("[requestId=").append(effectiveId).append("] ");
164      return sb
165         .append('[').append(res.getStatusCode()).append("] ")
166         .append("HTTP ").append(method).append(' ')
167         .append(uriStr)
168         .append(" (").append(req.getExecTime() != null ? req.getExecTime().toMillis() : 0).append("ms)")
169         .toString();
170   }
171
172   // The confirmed echoed id when present, else the sent id.
173   private static String effectiveRequestId(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
174      if (res != null && res.getRequestId() != null)
175         return res.getRequestId();
176      return req.getRequestId();
177   }
178
179   @Override /* RestClientDebugFormatter */
180   public String formatHeaders(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
181      var sb = new StringBuilder();
182
183      var reqLen = req.getCachedContentLength();
184      if (reqLen >= 0)
185         sb.append("\n\tRequest length: ").append(reqLen).append(" bytes");
186
187      sb.append("\n\tResponse code: ").append(res.getStatusCode());
188
189      var resLen = res.getCachedContentLength();
190      if (resLen >= 0)
191         sb.append("\n\tResponse length: ").append(resLen).append(" bytes");
192
193      var normalizedRedacted = normalizedRedactedSet();
194
195      if (!req.getResolvedHeaders().isEmpty()) {
196         sb.append("\n---Request Headers---");
197         for (var h : req.getResolvedHeaders())
198            appendHeaderLine(sb, h.name(), h.value(), normalizedRedacted);
199      }
200
201      if (!res.getHeaders().isEmpty()) {
202         sb.append("\n---Response Headers---");
203         for (var h : res.getHeaders())
204            appendHeaderLine(sb, h.name(), h.value(), normalizedRedacted);
205      }
206      return sb.toString();
207   }
208
209   private void appendHeaderLine(StringBuilder sb, String name, String value, Set<String> normalizedRedacted) {
210      // Order: mask (name-based, on the raw value) → escape (name, then whatever survived masking) → cap (none here).
211      var masked = isRedacted(name, normalizedRedacted) ? RedactedHeaders.REDACTED : value;
212      sb.append("\n\t").append(DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(name)).append(": ").append(DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(masked));
213   }
214
215   private Set<String> normalizedRedactedSet() {
216      return redactedHeaders.stream()
217         .filter(Objects::nonNull)
218         .map(BasicRestClientDebugFormatter::normalizeHeaderName)
219         .collect(Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new));
220   }
221
222   private static boolean isRedacted(String name, Set<String> normalizedRedacted) {
223      return name != null && normalizedRedacted.contains(normalizeHeaderName(name));
224   }
225
226   /** Case-folds and strips {@code -}/{@code _} and whitespace so {@code X-Auth-Token}/{@code X_Auth_Token}/{@code XAuthToken} all match. */
227   private static String normalizeHeaderName(String name) {
228      var sb = new StringBuilder(name.length());
229      for (var i = 0; i < name.length(); i++) {
230         var c = name.charAt(i);
231         if (c == '-' || c == '_' || Character.isWhitespace(c))
232            continue;
233         sb.append(Character.toLowerCase(c));
234      }
235      return sb.toString();
236   }
237
238   @Override /* RestClientDebugFormatter */
239   public String formatBody(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
240      var sb = new StringBuilder();
241      // Content-Type/Content-Encoding are resolved independently per side, each from that side's own finalized,
242      // wire-order header list — never reused across sides (Risk 5).
243      var reqCt = header(req.getFirstHeader("Content-Type"));
244      var reqCe = header(req.getFirstHeader("Content-Encoding"));
245      var resCt = header(res.getFirstHeader("Content-Type"));
246      var resCe = header(res.getFirstHeader("Content-Encoding"));
247      appendBody(sb, "Request", req.getCachedContent(), req.getCachedContentLength(), reqCt, reqCe);
248      appendBody(sb, "Response", res.getCachedContent(), res.getCachedContentLength(), resCt, resCe);
249      return sb.toString();
250   }
251
252   private static String header(TransportHeader h) {
253      return h == null ? null : h.value();
254   }
255
256   private void appendBody(StringBuilder sb, String label, byte[] content, long totalLength, String contentType, String contentEncoding) {
257      if (content == null || content.length == 0)
258         return;
259      var byteCount = totalLength >= 0 ? totalLength : content.length;
260      var ctToken = contentTypeToken(contentType);
261
262      if (! isAllowDumpBodies()) {
263         appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken, "; set " + ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES + " to enable", "body suppressed");
264         return;
265      }
266
267      if (! isRenderable(contentType, contentEncoding)) {
268         appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken, "; binary/non-renderable content", "body not rendered");
269         return;
270      }
271
272      var raw = new String(content, UTF8);
273      String bodyText;
274      if (bodyScrubber != null) {
275         String scrubbed;
276         try {
277            scrubbed = bodyScrubber.scrub(contentType, raw);
278         } catch (Throwable t) {  // NOSONAR - fail closed on any scrubber failure; never re-leak via the exception.
279            scrubbed = null;
280         }
281         if (scrubbed == null) {
282            appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken, "; scrubber failed", "body suppressed");
283            return;
284         }
285         bodyText = scrubbed;
286      } else {
287         bodyText = raw;
288      }
289
290      sb.append("\n---").append(label).append(" Content---");
291      sb.append('\n').append(DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(bodyText, charCap()));
292      var omitted = byteCount - content.length;
293      if (omitted > 0)
294         sb.append("\n\u2026[truncated ").append(omitted).append(" bytes]");
295   }
296
297   private void appendPlaceholder(StringBuilder sb, String label, long byteCount, String ctToken, String reason, String verb) {
298      sb.append("\n---").append(label).append(" Content---");
299      sb.append("\n[").append(verb).append(": ").append(byteCount).append(" bytes, ").append(ctToken).append(reason).append(']');
300   }
301
302   private String contentTypeToken(String contentType) {
303      if (ib(contentType))
304         return "unknown";
305      return DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(contentType);
306   }
307
308   private boolean isRenderable(String contentType, String contentEncoding) {
309      if (! isIdentityEncoding(contentEncoding))
310         return false;
311      return isBodyRenderable(contentType);
312   }
313
314   private static boolean isIdentityEncoding(String contentEncoding) {
315      if (contentEncoding == null)
316         return true;
317      var e = contentEncoding.trim();
318      return e.isEmpty() || eqic(e, "identity");
319   }
320
321   /**
322    * Returns the character-length cap for a dumped body, derived from {@link #bodyCap()}.
323    *
324    * <p>
325    * Worst-case escaping expands one byte to a 6-character {@code \\uXXXX} sequence, so the sanitized character cap
326    * is {@code bodyCap() * 6} (clamped to {@code Integer.MAX_VALUE}). Capture already bounds the raw bytes; this
327    * second layer bounds a scrubber that returns an oversized string.
328    */
329   private int charCap() {
330      var cap = Math.max(bodyCap, 0) * 6L;
331      return cap > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int) cap;
332   }
333
334   /**
335    * Returns whether body dumping is enabled by the {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES} environment
336    * variable.
337    *
338    * <p>
339    * Resolved once from the environment and cached. Never reads a system property. Keep byte-identical to
340    * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter}'s counterpart.
341    *
342    * @return <jk>true</jk> if body dumping is enabled.
343    */
344   static boolean isAllowDumpBodies() {
345      return RestDebugBodyGate.isAllowDumpBodies();
346   }
347
348   /**
349    * Parses a raw gate value with trim-then-parse truthy semantics.
350    *
351    * <p>
352    * The value is trimmed first; a non-empty trimmed value enables (returns <jk>true</jk>) except case-insensitive
353    * {@code false} or {@code 0}; {@code null}/empty/all-whitespace disables. This is a fail-safe kill switch, so
354    * ambiguous values resolve to disabled. Keep byte-identical to
355    * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter}'s counterpart.
356    *
357    * @param raw The raw environment value. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
358    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the value enables body dumping.
359    */
360   static boolean parseAllowDumpBodies(String raw) {
361      return RestDebugBodyGate.parse(raw);
362   }
363
364   /**
365    * Test-only seam for exercising both gate states without mutating the process environment.
366    *
367    * <p>
368    * Package-private and unreachable from application code, and never reads a system property. Production
369    * resolution stays env-only / read-once ({@link #isAllowDumpBodies()}).
370    *
371    * @param override {@code null} clears the cache so the next resolution re-reads the environment once; a
372    *    non-<jk>null</jk> value is cached directly as the test gate state.
373    */
374   static void resetAllowDumpBodiesForTest(Boolean override) {
375      RestDebugBodyGate.setAllowDumpBodiesForTest(override);
376   }
377}
